info.title: HypeLabs Partner API
info.description:
The HypeLabs Partner API lets resellers and tenants browse available proxy
stock, place orders (create allocations), and track allocation lifecycle
events such as expirations. Authenticate with your partner API key
(`hl_live_…`) sent in the `X-Api-Key` header; every request is scoped to the
organization it identifies.

👋  Not a partner yet? [Get started on the HypeLabs Console](https://console.hypelabs.network).

get.description: Returns the commercial catalog (products, pricing) enriched with available locations and ISPs.
Returns the available locations (with their ISPs). Pass productId to narrow to a product.
Returns the available ISPs. Pass productId and/or locationId to narrow the results.

post.description: Creates a customer for your organization.

get.description: Returns your organization's customers, most recent first. Filterable by active state, email-verified state, KYC approval, and a free-text search across all of a customer's fields.
Returns a single customer belonging to your organization.

put.description: Updates a customer's details. Fields left null are unchanged.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a customer from your organization.

patch.description: Approves or rejects the customer's submitted KYC.

get.description: Returns the incidents reported for your organization, most recent first.

post.description: Reports a new incident for your organization. Rejected with 409 if an incident is already open for the same target.

get.description: Returns a single incident belonging to your organization.

post.description: Computes the price for a selection (product, location, ISP, quantity) without placing an order.
Prices the selection and records the order.

get.description: Lists the partner's active orders. Filterable by status, billing cycle, payment method, trial flag, and a free-text search across all of an order's fields.

post.description: Records a short-lived trial order for the selection.
Renews an order for another billing cycle, optionally on different terms.

get.description: Returns a snapshot of all the partner's active proxies with their connection details.
Returns the connection details of a single allocated proxy.
Returns the credentials currently in effect on an allocated proxy, fetched live from the Manager.

post.description: Changes the username and password of an allocated proxy.

get.description: Returns the IP rotation configured on an allocated proxy, fetched live from the Manager.

put.description: Configures how often the proxy rotates its IP. A delay of 0 disables rotation.

post.description: Checks that an allocated proxy is reachable and measures its latency.
Triggers an immediate IP rotation on an allocated proxy.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Browse what's available to order: the products on offer, the locations they're available in, and the ISPs behind them. Use these to build a valid order before creating an allocation.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Place orders and manage their lifecycle. Creating an order reserves proxies for your organization; from there you can review, extend, and track each allocation through to expiration.

tags.name: Proxies
tags.description: Work with the proxies your organization has been allocated: list them, read their connection details, and manage them over their lifetime.

tags.name: Incidents
tags.description: Report and track incidents affecting your proxies: raise a new incident, list the open ones, and resolve them once they're handled.

tags.name: Customers
tags.description: Manage your own customers: the end users you integrate into your website, or who sign in through your white-label store. This is entirely optional. You don't need customers to place orders; use it only if you'd like us to store and manage your customers for you.
